title: About Marie Nussbaum — Clinical psychologist, Paris 7th
desc: Marie Nussbaum, clinical psychologist and psychoanalyst in Paris 7th: fifteen years in global companies before the consulting room, trained at Université Paris Cité.
bio1: Clinical psychologist and psychoanalyst, I see adults, adolescents and children at 26 boulevard Raspail, Paris 7th — in English and in French, in person or online.
bio2: Before the consulting room, I spent fifteen years in global companies, working alongside senior executives — including several years in London, Sweden and Australia. Trained at Université Paris Cité, my practice rests on continuous institutional experience — including two years at the psychoanalytic centre of the GHU Sainte-Anne — and regular supervision (UFORCA, EPFCL).
